text: かたさと　はやさを　もつので　はかいりょく　ばつぐんだ。

structure.jp: かたさと　はやさを　もつので
structure.en: because it has hardness and speed

structure.jp: はかいりょく　ばつぐんだ。

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので after a statement gives it as the reason for what follows. もつので = 'because it has them'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: Swapping the last い of a describing word for さ makes it a thing word, like '-ness'. かたさ = 'hardness'.
